title: S22+ bluetooth constant paring request
symptom: After upgrading to an S22+ and transferring settings via QR code, the user experiences intermittent Bluetooth pairing requests for the transmitter. The issue persists despite resetting Bluetooth and basic functions.
fix: The thread suggests adjusting settings to follow the recommended settings at https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/G6-Recommended-Settings.html. The user reported that this helped but did not fully resolve the issue, reducing the frequency from every 5 minutes to a couple times a day.
evidence_quote: To start, please adjust all settings to follow: https://navid200.github.io/xDrip/docs/G6-Recommended-Settings.html
